stories.headline: New FBS Podcast episode explains what goes into the Digest
stories.body: The FBS Podcast released “FBS 61 The Woods Run Digest” on November 9. The episode introduces the daily briefing for timberland owners, loggers, mill operators and wood-products managers in the United States and Canada.

featuredResource.title: National Forest Products Tax Credit Sourcebook
featuredResource.description: This searchable website and downloadable sourcebook help forest-products businesses screen federal and state tax-credit opportunities. Browse by state or activity and follow official sources to check eligibility and timing; it is a screening guide, not tax advice.
